title: Japan’s MMX Probe Sets Off for Mars’s Moon Phobos
paragraphs: A new space machine is on its way to Mars. It is called MMX. Japan sent it into space on 20 October 2026.
MMX will visit Phobos. Phobos is a small moon of Mars. No one has brought a piece of it to Earth.
The trip is long. MMX will reach Mars in 2027. It will take some rock from Phobos. Then it will fly home in 2031.
